findings.text: plan-vs-code: A delete patch inside a still-valid URL (for example, deleting `/qwerty` from `[글](https://example.com/qwerty)`) is skipped by patch_ranges, so it is allowed, but its zero-width markers are inserted before Markdown rendering and later replaced with HTML spans inside the href attribute. The resulting link is malformed instead of rendering the fully applied external link. — record: “패치(Q-patch)는 적용된 본문을 바꾸는 것이므로 바깥 링크를 넣거나 고치거나 지울 수 있다 — 바깥 링크는 패치가 모두 적용된 본문에서 해석된다. 끄면 표시가 사라지고 적용된 본문만 보인다.” — tree: “if isinstance(unit, DeletedUnit): unit_index += 1; continue; body, regions = patch_state.regions_and_marked_body(); rendered_blocks = [render_block(block, content_root, post_path, image_prefix, external_links=True) for block in blocks]; rendered_blocks = render_patched_blocks(rendered_blocks, patch_tokens); tokens[start] = f"<span{attributes}>"”
